findings.message: [review/consistency] This actor-exclusion filter contradicts the stated invariant of the phase specs this feature was built against. Spec 1f61f624 (phase 3) constrains: "The notification set is a function of the STATE CHANGE, not of who performed it: exactly TWO notificationService.create calls for SUBMITTED and APPROVED cancellations, exactly ONE for DRAFT" and "Self-notification is not suppressed: when the cancelling actor is the resolved recipient, the notification is still written. The exactly-one rule holds regardless of actor identity." Spec 9244f013 (phase 6) repeats it: "no case may assert suppression on the basis of the actor being the recipient", and its success criterion #3 requires the DRAFT case to assert exactly one notification. [review/test-coverage] This assertion inverts a pre-existing case rather than extending it additively. The phase-6 spec (9244f013) constrains "Additive extension only: every pre-existing test case ... must remain byte-for-byte in intent — no case deleted, renamed, skipped, or weakened", and its success criterion #3 requires "a DRAFT cancellation still produces EXACTLY ONE notification (requester only) — the pre-existing DRAFT assertion is unchanged and no approver notification is added on that path." The pre-existing DRAFT case previously asserted `toHaveLength(1)` with `recipientId === REQUESTER_ID`; it now asserts zero, and the sibling case at line 988 was renamed from "sends exactly one cancellation notification for the original" to "notifies only the requester when the canceller IS the recorded approver". ADR-004 in `docs/DECISIONS.md` records: "the repository applies only the `employeeIds` filter and the `status = 'SUBMITTED'` predicate", and lists as a REJECTED alternative "Passing `actorId`/`actorRole` into the repository and re-expressing the role-scoped visibility rule in SQL". findings.quoted_line: - `ILeaveRepository.findPendingDecisions(actorId: string, actorRole: EmployeeRole, client?: PoolClient): Promise<LeaveRequest[]>` — NEW. Returns the requests still awaiting this actor's decision: `status = SUBMITTED` AND `reverses_request_id IS NULL`, scoped by role (ADMIN: all; MANAGER: the requester's `employees.manager_id = actorId`; EMPLOYEE: none). `ORDER BY start_date ASC, id ASC`. Read-only: no `forUpdate`, no transaction, returns an array (possibly empty), never null. `CANCELLED` is excluded by construction, which is what makes a cancelled request stop being listed.

[review/documentation] The `LeaveRequestQueryParams` table's last row and the following `## balance` heading were joined onto one line, so the `balance` section heading is no longer a heading and the table row is malformed. Verified: `grep -n "^## " docs/DOMAIN.md` returns base, leave, employee, policy, notification, audit, validation, system, uptime — no `balance` — and the raw line is `| offset | number | false |## balance`. The `balance` domain section is therefore no longer addressable as a section in the document that is the source of truth for the domain model.
  Evidence: "| offset | number | false |## balance"
  Fix: Insert a newline between the table row and the heading so the line reads `| offset | number | false |` followed by a blank line and `## balance`.

On main all five consultable agents are `max_tokens: 32000`; here `domain-architect-agent` (952), `data-architect-agent` (979) and `app-architect-agent` (1009) are 6000, `chief-architect-agent` is 12000 and `planner-agent` is 24000. The deleted comment block recorded the measured basis for 32000 — "Per-agent observed maxima before this change (cap -> observed max completion, n): ... data-architect-agent 6,000 -> 9,100 n=12" and "1.11x HEADROOM IS NOT HEADROOM ... with no retry a cut-off consult is a FAILED consult, not a slower one". At 6000 the data-architect-agent cap sits below its own observed maximum (9,100), i.e. it truncates. The diff against `origin/main` for this file is 162 lines removed, 0 added apart from the `max_iterations` comment.

[review/architecture] This branch's `agents.yaml` reverts the consult completion cap that `origin/main` established. Verified with `git show origin/main:agents.yaml`: main sets `max_tokens: 32000` for all five consultable agents (domain-architect-agent, data-architect-agent, app-architect-agent, chief-architect-agent, planner-agent), with the rationale recorded in main's own comments ("1.11x HEADROOM IS NOT HEADROOM … 32,000 is 1.48x the pooled maximum"; "`data-architect-agent` was TRUNCATING at 0.66x"). On this branch those five are 6000 / 6000 / 6000 / 12000 / 24000 — i.e. the branch reintroduces the exact cap main documented as truncating. Because the merge is a squash, merging this branch silently undoes that decision. The same class of staleness applies to `review-agent`'s `token_budget: 1600000` (main: 1200000) and to `docs/DECISIONS.md`, where main's "🔴 RESTORED 2026-10-11" provenance note for CLARIFY-001..008 is absent on this branch.
